source_excerpts.text:
New internally reviewed result: the learning cost can depend on the small input-sensitive part of a channel, even when its noisy output is full-rank. The guarantee is near-optimal recovery fidelity, not restoration of erased information.

A separate streaming construction needs only a few large quantum registers, but trades that saving for continued source access and still-enormous sample costs.

The ZIP includes the proofs, reviews and a separate investigation of high-rank learning. I’m continuing the broader quantum work.
